items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I've heard of case in a place but never bass in a place.

ctx.x: That's right, well, that's, I think that's how we managed to get our instruments from place to place, we just threw them right in the hole in the side of the bass, you see.
Why don't we add it, let me tell them about Willie Guitar and his bass is adoring it. Maybe you know the story better than I do, Paul.

I want to get this out. This guy Willie Guitar, who played bass and lived on Music Street, he's an old time bass man around here. I don't know, some old guys like I think Sal Mojada and Huey Hardy were talking one time to Sat, talking to me in the group and they said that Willie had a bass, had a door cut in the back of his bass, a hinged door, well concealed, and he'd go to a house party and he'd stand around and he'd see something he wanted, he'd pick out something real nice and after the party got real juiced…
